data.name: Lakshmipriya
data.gender_notes: Lakshmipriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the goddess Lakshmi, the name Lakshmipriya signifies one who is beloved of the goddess. The name Lakshmipriya carries the meaning “Beloved of Lakshmi” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lakshmipriya usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved of lakshmi and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine love and blessings.
data.etymology: Lakshmipriya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved of Lakshmi.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lakshmipriya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The use of the name showcases the devotion and faith towards this goddess, placing her at the forefront of one's personal beliefs and values.
data.spiritual_significance: Lakshmipriya holds a profound spiritual significance for those who bear this name. It is believed that the goddess Lakshmi not only watches over and blesses her devotees with material wealth but also bestows upon them spiritual richness and inner happiness. This name serves as a constant reminder of one's connection to the divine and the blessings that come with it.
